messages:
deploybot: Packaging job started for private-installer v2.1.0-private at staging -> vpc transport window. artifact: bundle-v2.1.0.tgz

marta: starting checklist -- packing manifest, cosign, shrinkwrap. ETA ~20m. tagging as v2.1.0-private-rc1

sam: heads-up: I bumped the image base to ubuntu-24.04, doing a quick smoke build now.

li: FYI infra: transporting via s3-mirror -> offline-carrier, expected transit 60-90m. will open canary window 30m after delivery.

nisha: QA will run smoke + integration canary tests during that 30m. failing tests -> immediate hold.

marta: signing plan: cosign with transport-signer key ring. cosign cmd: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/release/transport-signer bundle-v2.1.0.tgz`

sam: hashing for verification: `sha256sum bundle-v2.1.0.tgz` -> `3b2f9a...e7c1` (recorded in manifest). also producing shrinkwrap: `shrinkwrap.json` pinned to 2.1.0-private-rc1

deploybot: Deploybot: artifact uploaded to mirror (s3://redwood-offline/bundles/2026-04/1712349012-bundle-v2.1.0.tgz) :white_check_mark:

tim: oncall check: rollback criteria? define now so ops knows when to abort transport.

marta: rollback triggers: 1) cosign verify fail on destination 2) checksum mismatch 3) QA canary >5 failing tests 4) signer KMS error during verification. If any trigger, we abort deploy and mark rollback -> use fallback bundle v2.0.7-offline (already staged).

seb: security: add additional check: image-sbom presence and cosign attestations required. If attestations missing, treat as cosign verify fail.

sam: noted. I'll add SBOM cdx.json and cosign attestations step to the packaging script.

nisha: QA will run `./tests/canary.sh --bundle path` and post results in this thread. threshold: <95% pass = hold, <90% = rollback.

li: transport ETA updated: mirror->carrier start 12:50 UTC, expected arrival in customer staging 14:10 UTC. canary open 14:20-14:50 UTC.

marta: release notes snippet ready, will attach to delivery manifest: "Private VPC installer v2.1.0-private: updated base image, improved kv-cache tuning, airgap transport improvements."

deploybot: Deploybot: scheduled canary window at 1712350800 (14:20 UTC). Will post delivery status when upload finishes.

nisha: canary run started: basic smoke + auth + perf-lite. posting summary in 10m.

nisha: canary summary: smoke OK, auth flows OK, perf-lite median latency +8% (within acceptable). 2 flaky integration tests failed intermittently. marking as pass-with-issues. recommend proceed with monitored rollout and 1-hour holdback.

marta: decision: proceed with rollout but holdback for full 1-hour observation and increased logging. escalate to oncall if new failures appear. documenting rollback reason/criteria in manifest.

tim: acknowledged. oncall will watch logs and traces. if errors spike >3x baseline or checksum/cosign issues surface, we will trigger immediate rollback to v2.0.7-offline.

seb: confirm attestations verified on destination?

sam: cosign verify OK on mirror and carrier edge: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/release/transport-signer bundle-v2.1.0.tgz` -> verified. attestations present.

deploybot: Deploybot: rollout started to private VPC pool (canary nodes 3/10). streaming logs: https://deploy.logs/release/1712349012

li: transport note: if any node reports legacy runtime mismatch (old cudnn) fallback will route to dedicated pool with forced quantization profile q8.

nisha: after 45m observation: no regression in core flows, flaky tests stabilized. recommending full release continue at 15:20 UTC.

marta: rolling out full release now. pinned manifest tag v2.1.0-private. archiving rc artifacts and updating release notes.

deploybot: Deploybot: rollout complete. full status: success on 98/100 canary criteria, 2 minor nonblocking warnings. closing thread. :tada:
